evals.prompt: Review this icon usage. A toolbar component imports `import { SearchOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';` and `import { Gear } from 'lucide-react';` and renders both glyphs in the same view, while the rest of the app renders icons via the shared `<Icon>` from '@ahaslides/ui'. Is this icon sourcing correct?
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C1 — one shared icon set, never mixed.
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs: glyphs must all come from the single shared AhaSlides SVG icon component, but this view mixes @ant-design/icons (a second set) and lucide-react (a third set) side by side — different stroke widths and corner radii read as unfinished. Fix: replace both with the shared <Icon name="magnifying-glass" /> and <Icon name="gear" /> so one set is used per view. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Flags @ant-design/icons and lucide-react as mixed second/third icon sets

evals.prompt: Review this icon usage. A search button renders `<Icon name="magnifying-glass" size={20} strokeWidth={2} />`. The designer eyeballed 20px against the adjacent text. Is the size and stroke correct?
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C2 — on-grid size with its paired line-width token.
evals.expected_output: C2 FAILs: 20px is off-grid — the only sanctioned sizes are 12 / 16 / 24 / 32, and 20px has no defined line width; the stroke is also hardcoded to 2 rather than the size's paired line-width token. Fix: snap to size={16} (cap height of adjacent text) and drop the hardcoded strokeWidth so the component derives the 1.5 line-width token. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Flags the hardcoded strokeWidth={2} and cites the paired line-width token

evals.prompt: Review this icon usage. A rated-star indicator uses `<Icon name="star" size={24} strokeWidth={3} />` to look bolder when active, and a settings glyph uses `<Icon name="gear" size={16} color="#6A1EBB" />`. Is emphasis and colour handled correctly?
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C3 — emphasis via variant; colour via token, not hardcoded hex.
evals.expected_output: C3 FAILs: emphasis must come from the fill (solid) variant, not a thickened stroke — strokeWidth={3} thickens the stroke to signal state; and colour must inherit currentColor or a semantic/brand token, never a hardcoded hex — #6A1EBB is a raw literal that drifts from the theme. Fix: use variant={isRated ? 'fill' : 'outline'} for emphasis and route colour through a token, e.g. color='var(--aha-colorPrimary)'. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Flags strokeWidth={3} as thickened stroke for emphasis instead of the fill variant
Flags the hardcoded hex #6A1EBB and recommends currentColor or a semantic token

evals.prompt: Review this icon usage. A settings control renders `<button><Icon name="gear" size={16} /></button>` — an icon-only button with no visible text, no aria-label, and no tooltip. Is the accessibility correct?
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C4 — accessibility: labelled, tooltipped, or hidden.
evals.expected_output: C4 FAILs: an icon-only button must carry an accessible name (aria-label on the button or an sr-only label) and a tooltip when the action isn't obvious — this button has neither, so it is invisible to screen readers. Fix: wrap in <Tooltip title="Settings"> and add aria-label="Settings" to the button. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Identifies the icon-only button as missing an aria-label / accessible name
